answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing, each measured. (1) Measured 2026-11-12 on akienasus: address.component_of costs about 8.5 ms a call (20 calls 171.4 ms) because it re-walks component_dirs (77 components, 6.5 ms) every call. (2) Measured 2026-11-12 on akienasus: validation_store._owned_by_the_proofs_component over 300 repo files took 2.66 s; over the 40-file closure of cairn/tools/base/validations/test_base_probes_report_to_the_watch.json, 0.37 s. (3) Measured 2026-11-12 by the orchestrator with py-spy on the home bus, pid 1881010, 100% of one core: codemother queueme -> constrain -> tester run_proof -> _read_closure -> validation_store -> address.component_of -> component_dirs, holding codemother's shim lock while reach timed out at 120 s. (4) Assumed and stated: the component set does not change within one call, so one walk serves every path in it.
answers.builder_check: Where and what. cairn/tools/base/address.py: factor the loop in component_of into _deepest_owner(target, resolved) where resolved is the list of resolved component dirs; component_of calls it with one walk; add components_of(paths, pkg_root=None) -> dict mapping each input path (as given) to its owner or None, walking component_dirs once. Proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_components_of_walks_once.py, two teeth: agreement over a sample of git ls-files paths plus one outside path; count calls by replacing address.component_dirs with a counting wrapper for the call. No open question.
